name: Polyquaternium-33
description: Polyquaternium-33 (CAS 69418-26-4 ) is a cationic copolymer of acrylamide and quaternary ammonium acrylate used in personal care formulations. It functions as a conditioning and film-forming agent. The polymer deposits a substantive charge on hair and skin surfaces to improve texture and manageability. In rinse-off hair care products such as shampoos and conditioners, it reduces static and improves wet combability. It enhances the sensory feel of treated hair while leave-on styling formulations use it to provide flexible hold. This ingredient maintains a lightweight, non-tacky finish across various cosmetic applications. Skin care and body wash products incorporate it to modify surface wetting behavior and deliver a smooth after-feel. It provides these benefits without leaving a heavy residue on the skin or hair surface. It also functions as a rheology modifier in aqueous gel systems, contributing to viscosity stability. This stability is maintained across a wide range of formulation pH values for versatile manufacturing use. Polyquaternium-33 is supplied as an aqueous solution, with active polymer content varying by grade. It is available in cosmetic-grade quality aligned with standard personal care industry specifications. Buyers should confirm active content, charge density, and molecular weight range with suppliers.
